state.background: Current final implementation checkpoint for the research-only Plan39 anchor-only category-share backtest. Inspect scripts/plan39/anchor-only-category-backtest.mjs, results/plan39/anchor-only-category-backtest/summary.json and annual-category-backtest.csv, data/source/cti-size-composition/README.md, and the newly added OpenSpec section at openspec/specs/nextjstest/spec.md under 'Research-only 2017-anchor-only category-share backtest'. Scope only this category-share backtest; do not assess production estimator, production loaders/gates, or quarterly outputs. No production path consumes these artifacts. An independent read-only review recomputed CSV metrics from annual rows and matched summary values to 12 digits, found no major issue, and noted the January setai proxy/trailing-12-month LFS definition, 2018 Household Survey redesign, and 2017/2022 LFS benchmark changes as caveats.
acceptanceCriteria: Use exact raw values from retained 2025-base CTI basic B statInfId 000040499069 and distribution-adjusted A statInfId 000040499087, sheet 総・年, all years 2017–2025. Source hashes, exact workbook/year/cell locations, raw values and statuses are recorded.

For each of ten categories, set only the 2017 anchor q[c]=pA[2017,c]/pB[2017,c]. Report requested raw formula pHatRaw[t,c]=pB[t,c]*q[c], and separately labeled normalized variant pHatNorm[t,c]=pHatRaw[t,c]/sum_j(pHatRaw[t,j]). Keep both predictions distinct.

Use 2017 for calibration/traceability only; validate on 2018–2025 (n=8, 80 category-year rows). Report per-category MAE/RMSE/bias in percentage points, macro metrics, annual actual/predictions/errors, and raw predicted annual category-share sums.

Raw macro MAE/RMSE/bias are .0358365/.0426404/-.0005984 pp; normalized macro metrics are .0358609/.0426805/+.0000018 pp. Annual raw predicted category-share sums range 0.999861–1.000021; normalized variant sums exactly to one by construction.

Other is derived as total minus the nine published categories for 2017–2019 where official Other cell is '-', then uses official numeric values for 2020–2025. Source method status is retained per workbook/year. Direct-versus-residual maximum difference is 0.0004 index points for B (2020) and 0.0003 for A (2021); treat this as a comparability boundary.

Document the research-only boundary and WHEN/THEN OpenSpec requirement. Caveats include the annual January setai-n snapshots as proxies for the trailing-12-month LFS correction share, not calendar-year averages; Household Survey redesign in 2018; and LFS benchmark changes effective Jan 2017 (2015 Census) and Jan 2022 (2020 Census).
Script generation completed; git diff --check passed. No tests were run.

knownConstraints: This is a research-only historical backtest and makes no production claim.
Annual January setai-n values proxy a trailing-12-month LFS share and must not be interpreted as calendar-year averages.
The validation period includes the 2018 Household Survey redesign and LFS benchmark changes beginning 2017 and 2022.
Other changes from residual-derived to published numeric values in 2020; its time-series metrics have that source-method boundary.
state.outputRequirement: Choose one listed choice. For any reason choice, provide a case-specific finding, affected artifact or requirement, observed evidence, and either a concrete proposed fix or exact additional evidence needed. Do not invent details.

implementation.instructions: Does the supplied evidence support accepting this bounded research-only category-share backtest against its stated formulas, validation split, source trace, and caveats? Return a probability distribution over the listed choices.

criteria.valid_as_defined: Evidence supports the research-only backtest and its declared limitations as defined.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A requirement conflicts with intended behavior; identify it and correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: A specific missing source or series definition prevents the declared backtest; state what is needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The implementation or evidence omits required formula, data, or validation evidence; identify it.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete source, calculation, or labeling defect exists; state location, evidence and bounded correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The implementation exceeds the research-only scope; identify boundary and adjustment.
criteria.other: A material concern does not fit the choices above; identify its location, evidence and fix or needed evidence.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied context cannot support a judgment; identify missing context if possible.
